response.sql: WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps FROM driver_stats;

assumptions.assumption: "Upwards of 12" means grid position >= 12 (includes position 12 itself)
The TEXT field `laps` contains numeric values that can be cast to FLOAT for averaging

alternatives.sql: WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps FROM driver_stats;
